title: Pakistan sets September 5 deadline for crypto firms to register
dek: Pakistan has mandated that crypto firms serving local users since March 2026 must apply for regulatory clearance by September 5, 2026, and subsequently incorporate domestically to continue operations.
author: Crypto Cronkite
key_fact: Crypto platforms must register by September 5 or lose access to Pakistani users; domestic incorporation is required after approval.
bottom_line: Watch for major exchange announcements in the weeks before September 5 on whether they will apply for Pakistani clearance and incorporate locally. The deadline will determine whether crypto platforms stay or exit the market, and whether Pakistan's regulatory framework attracts or repels major operators.
body: Crypto firms operating in Pakistan face a registration deadline of September 5, 2026. According to Decrypt, platforms that have served Pakistani users since March 2026 must apply for regulatory clearance by that date, with subsequent domestic incorporation required to continue operations legally.

The mandate creates a defined cutoff for crypto platforms in the country: those that do not apply by September 5 cannot legally serve Pakistani users going forward. The move signals Pakistan's intention to formalize oversight of the crypto sector rather than leave it unregulated.

Affected firms are those operating in the country as of March 2026. The regulatory process requires two steps: first, application for clearance by the September 5 deadline, and second, local incorporation to maintain market access afterward.
